name: CI

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.number }}-${{ github.event.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:
  push:
    # branches: [ "master" ] # Run after merging into the "master" target
    paths: # Run only if files relevant to CI have changed (i.e. not bench, contrib, doc, examples, utils or submodule folders)
      - '.flake8'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'MANIFEST.in'
      - 'Makefile'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'requirements*.txt'
      - 'setup.py'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tables/**'

  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ] # Run in PRs targeting the "master" branch
    types: # Avoid low-impact events like "edited" or "labeled"
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
    paths:
      - '.flake8'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - 'MANIFEST.in'
      - 'Makefile'
      - 'ci/**'
      - 'pyproject.toml'
      - 'requirements*.txt'
      - 'setup.py'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tables/**'
  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  PACKAGE: tables

jobs:

  sdist:
    name: Create sdist
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          submodules: true
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        name: Install Python
        with:
          python-version: 3.x
      - name: Ubuntu library headers
        run:  |
          sudo apt update
          # Keep in sync with "Prerequisites" in User's Guide.
          DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive sudo apt install -y --no-install-recommends libblosc-dev libbz2-dev libhdf5-dev liblz4-dev liblzo2-dev libsnappy-dev libzstd-dev zlib1g-dev
      - name: Source distribution
        run: |
          pip install build
          python -m build --sdist
      - name: Save source distribution
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: tables-sdist
          path: dist/*.tar.gz


  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.x"

      - name: Install lint dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          python -m pip install flake8 isort black packaging
          if [ -f requirements-lint.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements-lint.txt; fi

      - name: Check dependency constraints are in sync
        run: python ci/check_requirements_sync.py

      - name: Lint (flake8)
        run: |
          python -m flake8 --version
          python -m flake8 --count --show-source --statistics ${PACKAGE}

      - name: Lint (isort)
        run: |
          python -m isort --version
          python -m isort --check ${PACKAGE}

      - name: Lint (black)
        run: |
          python -m black --version
          python -m black --check ${PACKAGE}


  build:
    name: ${{ matrix.os }} ${{ matrix.python }} ${{ matrix.numpy }} ${{ matrix.name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    needs: sdist
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash -l {0}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false

        \ here are synthetic. They are never repository speedups.\nOnly previously\
        \ observed outcomes are exposed to a scheduling/selection policy.\n\"\"\"\n\
        import json\nimport os\nimport statistics\n\n\nPATTERNS = {\n    \"P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE\"\
        , \"P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE\", \"P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST\",\n    \"P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY\"\
        , \"P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT\", \"P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION\",\n}\n\n\ndef policy(pattern,\
        \ optimized=False):\n    values = {\n        \"P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE\": {\"\
        pause_after_failures\": 2 if optimized else 0,\n                         \
        \       \"notify_on_pause\": optimized, \"recovery\": \"explicit_owner_reset\"\
        },\n        \"P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE\": {\"suppress_unchanged_inputs\": optimized,\n\
        \                                \"meaningful_inputs\": [\"user_source\",\
        \ \"external_dependency\"]},\n        \"P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST\": {\"order\"\
        : \"previous_failure_ancestors_first\" if optimized else \"declared\",\n \
        \                                   \"cancel_other_jobs\": False},\n     \
        \   \"P-LIT-BUILD-PRIORITY\": {\"order\": \"priority_with_aging\" if optimized\
        \ else \"fifo\", \"max_wait\": 12},\n        \"P-LIT-BUILD-SELECT\": {\"skip_docs_after_observed_success\"\
        : optimized,\n                               \"always_build\": [\"source\"\
        , \"lockfile\", \"setup\"]},\n        \"P-LIT-DURATION-PREDICTION\": {\"predictor\"\
        : \"past_feature_mean\" if optimized else \"past_global_mean\",\n        \
        \                             \"initial_estimate\": 20, \"train_count\": 6},\n\
        \    }\n    return values[pattern]\n\n\ndef dataset(pattern, repeat):\n  \
        \  \"\"\"Three reproducible workloads; repeat changes durations, never visibility\
        \ rules.
